0.name: HEADER_HEIGHT
0.docs: Height of the column header strip.

350.name: can_redo
350.docs: Whether there is something to redo.

777.name: automatic_ink
777.docs: Text with no color of its own: the theme's ink, unless the cell's fill makes it hard to read.

348.name: set_file_name
348.docs: Changes the name Save offers; `.xlsx` is added when missing.

423.name: OVERFLOW_CELLS
423.docs: Empty cells to the right that left-aligned text may run into.

44.name: into
44.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

925.name: ravenrs_spreadsheet

346.name: to_csv
346.docs: The active sheet's values as CSV.

421.name: RESIZE_GRIP
421.docs: How close to a column header's edge a drag resizes the column.

773.name: clip_range
773.docs: A range cut to the area that exists on screen, so a whole column does not make a huge rectangle.

344.name: active_sheet
344.docs: The position of the sheet being shown.

419.name: surface
419.docs: The cells: painted for the visible window only, with headers that stay in place.

771.name: scroll_to_show
771.docs: The scroll offset that shows `cell`, if it is not in view now.

871.name: file_buttons
871.docs: Shows or hides Open and Save on the toolbar (shown by default).

342.name: select
342.docs: Selects a cell or a range given as `A1` or `A1:C3`.

869.name: labels
869.docs: Replaces the labels, which otherwise follow the application's language.

338.name: cell_text
338.docs: What a cell given as `A1` shows on the active sheet, with its number format applied.

286.name: file_name
286.docs: The name the workbook is saved under.

361.name: begin_edit
361.docs: Starts editing the active cell, from its content or from `text`.

713.name: Surface
713.docs: The scrolling grid of cells, with its headers.

7.name: Axis
7.docs: One direction of the grid: every line has the default size except the listed ones.

334.name: replace
334.docs:
Replaces the workbook with the one in a file's bytes, as [`Self::open`] reads them.
Undo starts over.

811.name: for_culture
811.docs: The labels for a language and region such as `pt-BR`.

282.name: version
282.docs: Goes up after every change, so the views showing the workbook rebuild.

332.name: new
332.docs: A new, empty workbook with one sheet.

3.name: geometry
3.docs: Where rows and columns sit, in logical pixels, with their custom sizes.

330.name: execute
330.docs:
Runs one of the engine's commands, such as `cell.set`, `home.bold` or `edit.undo`,
with its parameters, and gives what it answered. A refused command changes nothing and
its reason shows under the formula bar.

355.name: with_session
355.docs:
Runs `f` with the engine's session, for commands with replies or state not covered here.
Views showing the workbook rebuild afterwards.

1.name: ROW_HEADER_WIDTH
1.docs: Width of the row header strip.

428.name: ColumnEdge
428.docs: Near the right edge of a column's header.

780.name: cell_look
780.docs: How one cell looks, or nothing when it has no fill, no borders and no text.

351.name: read
351.docs: Reads the workbook, for anything the methods here do not cover.

349.name: can_undo
349.docs: Whether there is something to undo.

347.name: file_name
347.docs: The name Save offers, ending in `.xlsx`.

422.name: MIN_COLUMN
422.docs: Narrowest a column gets by dragging.

772.name: picture
772.docs: Works out what the visible window shows, and the size of the whole scrollable area.

495.name: offset_row
495.docs: The first row in view, where a whole column selection puts its active cell.

545.name: Edge
545.docs: A line along one edge of a cell.

872.name: read_only
872.docs: Lets the workbook be read, selected and copied, but not changed.

595.name: clip
595.docs: Where its text may draw: wider than `rect` when text runs into empty neighbors.

343.name: sheet_names
343.docs: The names of the sheets, in order.

418.name: SPARE_ROWS
418.docs: Lines kept past the used area and the visible window, so there is always room to scroll.

770.name: clamped
770.docs: Keeps a drag that left the surface on its edge.

870.name: toolbar
870.docs: Shows or hides the toolbar (shown by default).

14.name: at
14.docs: The line under `position`, the last one past the end.

341.name: selection
341.docs: The selection, as `A1:B2` (areas joined by commas).

668.name: Picture
668.docs: Everything the paint function needs, worked out during the build.

491.name: cell_rect
491.docs: The cell's rectangle relative to the surface.

793.name: grid
793.docs: The grid's name, for screen readers.

339.name: cell_input
339.docs: What editing a cell given as `A1` starts from: its formula, or the value as typed.

766.name: shortcut
766.docs: Cmd or Ctrl with a letter.

489.name: Grid
489.docs: Rows, columns and scroll, enough to turn a point into a cell.

337.name: set_cell
337.docs:
Types `input` into a cell given as `A1`: a number, text, a date or a `=formula`, read as
a person typing it would be.

362.name: commit_edit
362.docs: Types the edit in progress into its cell, then moves the active cell by (`dr`, `dc`).

714.name: editor
714.docs: The text field over the cell being edited.

285.name: error
285.docs: The latest refusal from the engine, shown until the next command.

158.name: EditPlace
158.docs: Where an edit in progress is typed.

812.name: from_texts
812.docs: The texts of a catalog, in its language. What it does not have comes from English.

6.name: count
6.docs: Lines past the last one do not exist.

333.name: open
333.docs:
Opens a workbook from the bytes of a file: `.xlsx`, `.xlsm`, `.xls`, `.ods`, `.csv` or
`.tsv`, told apart by `name`'s extension and by the content.

660.name: merges
660.docs: Merged areas, which hide the gridlines inside them.

433.name: Hit
433.docs: Where a point falls on the surface.

281.name: state
281.docs: The workbook a [`Spreadsheet`](crate::Spreadsheet) shows, shared with the application.

4.name: custom
4.docs: Lines with their own size (zero when hidden), in order.

331.name: SpreadsheetState

356.name: error
356.docs: The latest refusal from the engine, if the last command was refused.

229.name: Edit
229.docs: An edit in progress: what the person typed so far, for which cell.

329.name: Spreadsheet
329.docs:
A spreadsheet: toolbar, formula bar, the grid of cells and the sheet tabs.

Click or drag to select, type to replace a cell, double-click or F2 to edit it, Enter and
Tab to move on. Cmd or Ctrl with C, X, V, Z, Y, B, I, U and A copy, cut, paste, undo, redo,
format and select all. Dragging a column header's edge sizes the column, and double-clicking
it fits the column to its content.

354.name: version
354.docs: Goes up after every change: reading it in a view rebuilds that view on the next one.

806.name: auto_sum
806.docs: Sums the cells above or to the left.
